located_claims: BFloat16 contains a uint16_t word and uses one sign bit, eight exponent bits and seven fraction bits.
CPU BF16-to-FP32 conversion shifts that uint16 word left by 16 before a memcpy into float.

coverage.applicability: Exact installed header SHA256 matches this fixed commit. Together with NP03, supports the native exponent-mask check without widening.
coverage.contrary_or_different_scope: numeric_limits reports is_iec559=false; this report does not claim full IEEE-754 conformance. CPU raw storage evidence is distinct from NPU arithmetic behavior.
